# Meok Omnibus Tracker MCP

> EU AI Act + GDPR + DORA Digital Omnibus tracker — track all 8 cliff dates, 14 article changes, an...

`meok-omnibus-tracker-mcp` is a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server by MEOK AI Labs.

## Install

```bash
pip install meok-omnibus-tracker-mcp
```

Or run without installing:

```bash
uvx meok-omnibus-tracker-mcp
```

## Tools

See the package README for the full tool list: https://pypi.org/project/meok-omnibus-tracker-mcp/
